```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(psych)
library(corrplot)
library(magrittr)
library(scales)
library(MASS)
```

## Opening Data

```{r}
study1 <- read_csv("/Users/luiza/Projects/ERIM/Study_1/bpe_study1.csv")
```
## Models

```{r}
model1 <- lm(rescale(coop) ~ rescale(bpe) + rescale(pt) + rescale(ec) + party_strength + age + race + gender + edu, data = study1)
summary(model1)
confint(model1)
model2 <- lm(rescale(animosity) ~ rescale(bpe) + rescale(pt) + rescale(ec) + party_strength + age + race + gender + edu, data = study1)
summary(model2)
confint(model2)
```
